Jekyll Portfolio Site - GitHub Pages Ready

This is a complete Jekyll portfolio site optimized for GitHub Pages deployment.

Key Features:
- Bootstrap 5 responsive design
- Project collection with card layouts
- Automated GitHub Actions workflow
- Sample project and placeholder content

Setup Instructions:
1. Update _config.yml with your details
2. Replace placeholder content in pages
3. Add your projects to _projects/ directory
4. Replace sample images in assets/images/
5. Push to GitHub and enable Pages with GitHub Actions

Work through each checklist item systematically.
Keep communication concise and focused.
Follow development best practices.
